description:
Simple Quiz FR is a quiz application available in French only, designed to provide a simple, accessible, and ad-free experience.
The app lets users answer multiple-choice quizzes by selecting various criteria such as category and difficulty level. The questions are provided by the « Simple Quiz API » (https://quizzapi.jomoreschi.fr/)
Users can also create and submit their own questions directly from the app, contributing to the community effort by enriching the shared question database.
Main features:
• Quizzes in French
• Category selection
• Difficulty level selection
• Reporting of malformed quizzes
• Creation and submission of questions
• Modern UI based on Material Design
• Light and dark themes
• Dynamic colors based on Material You
• Free and without ads
The app is built using a modern architecture based on Jetpack Compose and adheres to Android's best practices. User preferences are stored locally on the device.
The Internet permission is used only to communicate with the quiz API. No other permissions are required.
Simple Quiz FR is free and open-source software. The source code is publicly available, allowing anyone to review, modify, or improve the application.
